scope: Automated equivalent of the NSIS install/uninstall cycle, per the repository's automation policy (no owner/human action). NOT the NSIS uninstaller itself.
whyEquivalent: The signed NSIS installer requests elevation (electron-builder sets the elevated execution level because allowToChangeInstallationDirectory: true), and this non-interactive shell is a non-elevated Medium-integrity session, so the installer launch is refused with ERROR_CANCELLED (1223). Per the owner's automation policy a script/agent equivalent is used and labelled as such.

uninstallEquivalent.externalStateCheck: After the runs, %APPDATA%\Verse Claw-nodejs, %APPDATA%\verse-claw and %LOCALAPPDATA%\verse-claw-updater all pre-date this session (2026-07-06 / 2026-08-20 / 2026-10-07); the probes wrote only to the designated VERSE_CLAW_USER_DATA_DIR. No HKCU Uninstall 'Verse Claw' entry exists because the NSIS install never ran.
uninstallEquivalent.orphanCheck: No surviving 'Verse Claw' process after each run or after a hard kill.
uninstallEquivalent.nsisUninstallerStaticCheck: scripts/installer.nsh customUnInstall removes the resources\cli PATH entry via resources/cli/win32/update-user-path.ps1 -Action remove, kills lingering process trees, and only deletes AppData when the user opts in (deleteAppDataOnUninstall: false).

gap: The NSIS installer's own PATH add/remove and uninstaller reclamation remain unverified because the installer requires an interactive elevated session.
validationBoundary: This is an agent-driven equivalent of install+run+remove. It proves the installer payload is complete and the app works from an installed layout, but it does not execute the NSIS uninstaller.

silentInstallProbe.observed: The signed NSIS installer returns exit code 2 (NSIS abort) or 0 with no effect and writes nothing to the requested directory, the default per-user location, or HKCU Uninstall, in this non-interactive non-elevated session.
silentInstallProbe.interpretation: The assisted installer (oneClick:false, allowToChangeInstallationDirectory:true) needs an interactive desktop session; it cannot be driven headlessly here.
